mapper.select: SELECT spo.ORDER_ID FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS spo LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd1 ON spo.TRADE_ID = tpd1.TRADE_ID AND ( tpd1.IS_CANCEL IS NULL OR tpd1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) AND tpd1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd2 ON spo.TRADE_ID = tpd2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND ( tpd2.IS_CANCEL IS NULL OR tpd2.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_NO}) AND tpd2.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} WHERE tpd1.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} OR tpd2.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
